name: freevectoricons
description: Connect your agent to a FreeVectorIcons design collection: read the brief and DESIGN.md, search and fetch icons and brand assets, and save work back as versions.

FVI_TOKEN.title: Collection token
FVI_TOKEN.description: Collection-scoped token (fvi_col_…) from FreeVectorIcons → your collection → Integrations → Setup MCP. The collection is derived from this token. Never commit this value.

FVI_API_URL.title: API base URL
FVI_API_URL.description: API origin including /api. Leave the default for production.

FVI_READ_ONLY.title: Read only
FVI_READ_ONLY.description: Set true to hide write tools (park, upload, version).
